description: Elevate your everyday look with this stunning gold-toned necklace and earring set, beautifully crafted with delicate leaf-shaped charms adorned with sparkling marquise-cut crystals. An adjustable clasp ensures a comfortable and secure fit for all neck sizes. The matching hook earrings mirror the leaf motif, creating a perfectly coordinated ensemble. This versatile jewellery set pairs effortlessly with traditional Indian attire such as sarees and salwar suits, as well as contemporary outfits, making it ideal for festive occasions, weddings, and everyday wear. The warm gold finish combined with the brilliant crystal detailing gives this set a timeless, elegant appeal that is sure to draw admiring glances.
